2 شذّر النَّظْمَ , inf. n. تَشْذِيرٌ, He divided the strung beads with other beads. (O. [See شَذْرٌ, below.]) ―
-b2- Hence, by way of comparison, (TA,) شذّر كَلَامَهُ بِشِعْرٍ (tropical:) [He interspersed his language with poetry]: but this is post-classical. (O, TA.) ―
-b3- شذّر بِهِ He rendered him notorious, or infamous: or made him to hear what was bad, evil, abominable, or foul: (O, TA:) and in like manner شتّر به. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
